title: XTRA POWER GOLD High Torque Bits, 65mm Pack of 10
description: XTRA POWER GOLD High Torque Bits, 65mm Pack of 10 - Distributed/Packaged by Xtra Power. Product Details: The XTRA POWER Gold PH2 Screwdriver Bits are precision-engineered fastener drive bits designed for professionals and DIY enthusiasts who demand reliability and performance. Measuring 65mm in length, these bits are crafted from high-grade TS2 material, ensuring exceptional durability and resistance to wear even under demanding conditions. The high torque design allows for efficient power transfer, reducing cam-out and stripping of screw heads during heavy-duty applications. The gold finish not only adds a premium look but also enhances corrosion resistance, making these bits suitable for prolonged use. Compatible with most standard power drills and screwdrivers, the PH2 tip fits Phillips head screws commonly used in woodworking, construction, and general assembly tasks. This pack of 10 bits ensures you always have a spare on hand, making it ideal for both workshop and on-site use. Whether you are a seasoned tradesperson or a home improvement enthusiast, these XTRA POWER bits deliver consistent performance and longevity.
